title: 数据探针：理解数据如何影响LLM性能的系统方法
summary: 本文提出开发“数据探针”系统方法，通过从随机过程生成合成序列，观察LLM行为，以理解数据特征如何影响模型性能、泛化性和鲁棒性，超越经验启发式。
summary_en: This position paper advocates for developing 'data probes'—systematic synthetic sequences from random processes—to fundamentally understand how data characteristics influence LLM performance, generalization, and robustness, moving beyond empirical heuristics.
